relationships.subject: Z944
relationships.evidence_quote: Z944 mediated ∼100-fold more potent inhibition of Cav3.2 currents than ABT-639

relationships.subject: ABT-639
relationships.evidence_quote: the latter blocking channel activity by less than 15 percent when applied at a concentration of 30 μM

relationships.subject: ABT-639
relationships.evidence_quote: In the CFA model, both compounds reversed thermal hyperalgesia upon systemic delivery

relationships.subject: Cav3.2
relationships.evidence_quote: ABT-639 lost its analgesic effects in CFA treated Cav3.2 null mice, indicating that these channels are essential for ABT-639-mediated pain relief

key_findings: ABT-639 is a weak Cav3.2 inhibitor (<15% at 30 uM) vs Z944, and acts primarily at peripheral sites (intrathecal ineffective).
ABT-639 analgesia is lost in Cav3.2 null mice, so Cav3.2 is required for its effect.
